info.title: API.SH: Williams-Sonoma
info.description: The Williams-Sonoma API from API.SH: public Williams-Sonoma data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

The shop's category tree: ids (usable as `category` in search), names and product counts, from the top or below one category, one to three levels deep.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/williams-sonoma-categories

get.description:
One product of a Williams-Sonoma, Inc. shop by its id (the slug in /products/<id>/) or link: name, link, images, description, product information, sale and regular price ranges, discount, price type, leader SKU, flags, badges, every swatch with its own prices, categories and attributes, plus `raw`. Reviews are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/williams-sonoma-product

get.description:
Search the catalog of Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Mark and Graham or Rejuvenation (`brand`) by keywords, or browse a category, with the shop's filters (facet values from the response), a price range and its sort orders. Each product: id, name, link, images, description, sale and regular price ranges, discount, price type, leader SKU, flags, badges, swatches with per-swatch prices, categories and attributes, plus `raw`. Also returns the facets with counts and the matching categories. A keyword the shop sends to a category page browses that category (`redirected_to`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/williams-sonoma-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when category is set.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Shop: ws (Williams Sonoma, default), pb (Pottery Barn), we (West Elm), pbk (Pottery Barn Kids), pbteen (Pottery Barn Teen), mg (Mark and Graham), rejuvenation.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (from /williams-sonoma/v1/categories or a /shop/... link); alone it browses the category, with q it narrows the search.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as name:value;name:value (several values of one name joined by |), names and values as in `facets`, e.g. material:Linen|Cotton;armStyle:Slope Arm.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Stores near a point: store number, name, brand, type, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, opening hours per day, pickup and ship-to-store flags. By default only the chosen brand's stores; `all_brands=true` lists every Williams-Sonoma, Inc. store.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/williams-sonoma-stores

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Shop: ws (Williams Sonoma, default), pb (Pottery Barn), we (West Elm), pbk (Pottery Barn Kids), pbteen (Pottery Barn Teen), mg (Mark and Graham), rejuvenation.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
